variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
